fact_text: A stock exchange notice on 13 Nov 2025 said Maple Leaf Cement sought to acquire close to 157 million Pioneer Cement shares to gain full control.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The deal includes a public offer for 26.6 million Pioneer Cement shares.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The tender offer was scheduled for about 8 Feb 2026 and was to run for roughly a week.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: Under takeover rules, a sponsor taking a stake of 30% or more must float a tender offer, and the offer must be at the highest price the sponsor paid.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: Pioneer Cement traded at about Rs 220 when the acquisition notice came in mid-November 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: Pioneer Cement traded at about Rs 400 on 18 Dec 2025, a rally of about 80% in roughly one month, the reporter said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: Pioneer Cement's share price reached a high of about Rs 427 after the acquisition notice.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The acquisition was priced at about $80 per tonne of enterprise value, which the reporter described as a premium.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: Pioneer's earnings over the 12 months to 18 Dec 2025 were about Rs 25 per share, or roughly Rs 5 billion in total.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst said Pioneer's forward earnings multiple is already about nine times, so the deal price leaves limited upside.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst said DG Khan Cement, Cherat Cement and Kohat Cement were available at more attractive valuations than Pioneer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst attributed much of the share price fall after the notice to profit-taking by holders who had owned the stock for a long time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst assumed about 50% acceptance in the tender offer, and said acceptance could rise if some holders choose not to tender.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst computed that a position at about Rs 400 would return about 10% in roughly two months if half the holders accept the Rs 478 tender price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst said Pioneer's price may stay volatile until the tender offer closes, with profit-taking continuing alongside it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst said Maple Leaf could later delist Pioneer and merge it into Maple Leaf Cement, once its holding reaches about 88%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: After the deal the Maple Leaf group would hold about 88.2% of Pioneer, leaving about 11.8% free float, after a prior holding of about 18%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: After the acquisition Maple Leaf Cement would become the third-largest player in the Pakistani cement industry.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The combined market share of Maple Leaf and Pioneer would be about 15%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The combined capacity of Maple Leaf and Pioneer would be about 13.3 million tonnes, as spoken in the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: Local cement dispatches were said to be up about 15% over the five months to 18 Dec 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst expected cement dispatches to keep growing in H2 FY26, though at a slower pace because the prior-year base has risen.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: Cement demand was said to have not grown for four years to 18 Dec 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: Cement sector results for Q1 FY26 were below expectations, the reporter said, and sector shares had been weak for months before the deal.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst said the Afghanistan issue has pushed up coal prices and hit exports, which could make Q2 FY26 earnings softer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst expected margins to recover once Afghan coal returns and coal prices ease.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: A policy rate cut had been made by 18 Dec 2025, which the analyst said could support cement activity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The deal was said to be about Rs 75 billion in size, and is being done all in cash.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst estimated that if 50% of the deal is debt-financed, about Rs 37 billion would be borrowed, and the acquisition would weigh on finance cost in the short term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: Maple Leaf's balance sheet was said to hold about Rs 12 billion of cash, and the group generates about Rs 16 billion of cash a year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst said Maple Leaf's debt-to-capital ratio is under 10%, and management described the acquisition as highly leveraged.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: At about 55% capacity utilisation, the analyst estimated Pioneer's profit at about Rs 5 billion, which could nearly double if demand grows.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)

fact_text: The analyst said the Maple Leaf deal may be followed by further acquisitions, as the group aims to be the number two player in the sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MLCF bold bet on PIOC | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-18)
